description: Two multimode filters, each with its own input, drive and choice of low pass, band pass or high pass, and a crossfade between the two at a third output

params.text: Sets that filter's cutoff frequency, from 23Hz to 16384Hz
Sets that filter's Q, from 1 to 10
Attenuates the FM I input of that filter, from nothing to its whole range
Attenuates and inverts the FM II input of that filter
Shapes the signal before that filter, hardening it clockwise and softening it anticlockwise
Crossfades the MIX output between the left filter and the right one
Sets the level going into that filter
Chooses what that filter's output carries: low pass, band pass or high pass

inputs.text: Moves that filter's cutoff, attenuated by its FM I knob, 5V covering the whole range
Moves that filter's cutoff, attenuated by its FM II attenuverter, 5V covering the whole range
Moves that filter's Q, 5V covering the whole range and added to the Q knob
Adds to that filter's drive, -5V to 5V on top of its Drive knob
The signal into the left filter, scaled by its Amp knob
The signal into the right filter, scaled by its Amp knob
Moves the crossfade at the MIX output, 10V taking it to the right filter, added to the FADE knob

outputs.text: The crossfade between the two filter outputs

notes: both amp knobs start at zero, and each sets the level going into its own filter, so neither filter output carries anything until the one being used is raised
